what: GOALL: the GO ancestor closure as a recursive CTE
title: Querying human gene annotation via biocOnIce with org.Hs.eg.ice
text: OrgDb’s GOALL (ancestor closure GO DAG) needs ontology.relationship, table package wrap – attach directly, bioc--ice’s README shows cell types. CTE (common table expression) named, temporary result set defined name (...) immediately query uses . RECURSIVE lets CTE refer , query starts one gene’s direct GO terms repeatedly joins back ontology.relationship pick term’s is_a parents, one level DAG time, new ancestors found: query exactly GOALL/select(..., columns = "GOALL") can never return one AnnotationDbi call – package doesn’t need invent API , recursive CTE already SQL.
code: con <- ice_con() DBI::dbGetQuery(con, "     WITH RECURSIVE ancestors(go_id) AS (         SELECT go_id FROM bioc.annotation.ncbi__gene_go         WHERE gene_id = '7157' AND taxon_id = 9606 AND valid_to IS NULL         UNION         SELECT r.object_id         FROM bioc.ontology.relationship r         JOIN ancestors a ON r.subject_id = a.go_id         WHERE r.predicate = 'is_a' AND r.ontology = 'go' AND r.valid_to IS NULL     )     SELECT DISTINCT t.term_id, t.name     FROM ancestors a     JOIN bioc.ontology.term t ON t.term_id = a.go_id AND t.valid_to IS NULL; ") |>     head(10) term_id                                                             name 1  GO:2000379 positive regulation of reactive oxygen species metabolic process 2  GO:0005654                                                      nucleoplasm 3  GO:0070245               positive regulation of thymocyte apoptotic process 4  GO:1990841                              promoter-specific chromatin binding 5  GO:0006974                                              DNA damage response 6  GO:0000122        negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II 7  GO:0005829                                                          cytosol 8  GO:0030330   DNA damage response, signal transduction by p53 class mediator 9  GO:0042981                                  regulation of apoptotic process 10 GO:0032991                                       protein-containing complex

title: Querying human gene annotation via biocOnIce with org.Hs.eg.ice
text: Every accessor stays live default. Live-catalog latency real – single filtered query network can take seconds, dominated S3/catalog metadata overhead rather result size (PlanFor3.24.md Milestone 8 measured 0.099s org.Hs.eg.db locally versus 4.15s live hs_gene()/hs_pubmed() join). ’s problem session, ice_cache_refresh() pulls four tables local BiocFileCache-managed DuckDB file; pass cache = TRUE accessor read instead. alias/identifier_mapping table dominates refresh time – 6.59M rows, ~740s – versus well two minutes combined gene, go, pubmed. full refresh slow run vignette build time, ’s shown evaluated : skip_alias = TRUE omits table keeps refresh well two minutes – run build time: real end--end run (full refresh, alias included) measured 0.090s cached versus 15.987s live hs_gene()/hs_pubmed() join gene – 178x. hs_alias(cache = TRUE) errors cleanly alias skipped: Nothing calls ice_cache_refresh() automatically, nothing expires cache automatically – call want fresher copy, ice_cache_clear() remove . caching layer provisional: yet tag cache bioc--ice provenance.release identifier, makes cross-table-consistency claim beyond live catalog provides. See PlanFor3.24.md Milestone 8’s open caveat cross-table atomicity – row-level versioning applied per table independently, filtering hs_gene() hs_pubmed() “” nominal release , , prove join point--time consistent.

title: org.Hs.eg.ice
text: Every accessor stays live default. live-catalog latency problem session, ice_cache_refresh() pulls four tables local BiocFileCache-managed DuckDB file; pass cache = TRUE accessor read instead live catalog: Nothing calls ice_cache_refresh() automatically, nothing expires cache automatically – call want fresher copy, ice_cache_clear() remove . provisional implementation PlanFor3.24.md Milestone 8, built demonstrate latency difference; yet tag cache bioc--ice provenance.release identifier, makes cross-table-consistency claim beyond live catalog provides (see Milestone 8’s open caveat ). real end--end run (2026-10-22) confirmed speedup: hs_gene(cache=TRUE) |> filter(symbol=="ORMDL3") |> collect() took 0.090s versus 15.987s live. refresh took ~869s total, almost entirely alias/identifier_mapping (6.59M rows, ~739s) – gene, go, pubmed together took well two minutes. ice_cache_refresh() prints per-table progress (pulling ... / N rows Ns) since isn’t fast enough run silently. don’t need hs_alias() (cross-reference lookups), ice_cache_refresh(skip_alias = TRUE) skips cuts refresh well two minutes; hs_alias(cache = TRUE) errors telling refresh without skip_alias.
code: library(org.Hs.eg.ice) ice_cache_refresh()                       # one-time, explicit, slow call  hs_gene(cache = TRUE) |>     dplyr::filter(symbol == "ORMDL3") |>     dplyr::left_join(hs_pubmed(cache = TRUE), by = "gene_id") |>     dplyr::collect()
